finalText:
**Big but shallow.** 1,291 spots, 94 files. Only service code is safe.

| Do not rename | Why |
|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk`, 20 | `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits |
| `migrations/*.sql`, 61 | already ran in production |
| SQL text in 25 repo files, 125 | column is still `account_id` |
| `docs/openapi.yaml`, 5 | public contract, breaks clients |
| `WIRE` value in `lib/serialize.js` | the public JSON key |

There are no tests here.
